note: Cogent's lead asset bezuclastinib (selective KIT D816V inhibitor) targets systemic mastocytosis (also GIST). Epidemiology anchor: Orphanet ORPHA:2467 systemic mastocytosis, point prevalence 1-5 / 10,000 worldwide (ingested under data/COGT/orphanet/, e.g. orpha2467-point-prevalence-worldwide-*.json), i.e. roughly 33k-165k US patients across the SM spectrum; advanced SM and treated non-advanced SM are the addressable subset. Orphanet-grounded, so a small rare-disease count is legitimate (below the plausibility floor is expected). relevant_doc_ids uses the stable ORPHA:2467 family id, which family-matches every ingested SM prevalence/incidence record.
